style: Detailed hand-painted cozy Vietnamese isometric game illustrations. Soft painterly shading, warm pastel foliage and terracotta, organic irregular foundation, transparent alpha, wide clear margins. No people, labels, logos or watermark.

assets.prompt: Vietnamese folk fairground with ring toss stalls, lanterns, bunting and an oval brick courtyard.
Oval dog racing track with sandy lanes, white rails, timber starting gate, mint-roof kiosk and grassy infield.
Yellow dormitory with external stairs and a mint boarding-house row, shared courtyard, clothesline and bicycle.
Five-storey pastel blue apartment block, flowered balconies, lobby canopy and asymmetrical garden forecourt.
Staggered terrace of three narrow two-storey pastel townhouses with red tile roofs, shutters and curving front walkway.
Warm cream villa with red tiled roofs, veranda, wrought iron gate, tropical garden, curved pond and stepping stones.
